'''Pova''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who was active during the time of the [[Order of Zildrog campaign]]. During a mission on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], she encountered another female spy while riding on a [[Rocket tram|train]]. After engaging one another in combat, they got to talking and realized that neither of them were ordered to kill the other, and so decided to go their separate ways. Next morning on the train, Pova once again encountered the other spy. In order to avoid public recognition, they used their mutually-inflicted injuries as a cover for striking up a conversation, exchanging fake names and made-up stories behind their injuries, and ending up enjoying one another's company so much that they both missed their train stops. The two ended up forming a romantic relationship.<ref name="Chasing Copero" />

Soon after [[Theron Shan]]'s [[Crisis on Umbara|mission]] on [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]], Pova helped Shan to locate the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Copero/Legends|Copero]], providing him with [[Star map/Legends|star charts]] courtesy of her lover, as well as background on Copero and the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Inrokini family|House Inrokini]].<ref name="Chasing Copero" />
